primary_source.title: Exact Periodic Solutions of the Forced Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations in Arbitrary Dimensions
primary_source.author: R. K. Michael Thambynayagam
primary_source.license_record: arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license to distribute the article; ancillary-code reuse license not established

finding: Independent SymPy replay confirms the exact smooth 3D forced periodic base solution identities; the base solution decays with fixed spatial Fourier support and is not itself a concentration trajectory.

paper_reported_numerics.method: pseudospectral with two-thirds dealiasing and midpoint/integrating-factor time integration
paper_reported_numerics.underresolution_example: At Re=3000, the 96^3 tail is below 1e-4, yet refinement to 128^3 changes the reported peak vorticity by about 20%; the paper treats tail cutoff as necessary but insufficient.
paper_reported_numerics.localization_result: Systematic enhancement over unforced evolution is not established; runs cross and the final unforced peak occurs after the cited spectral resolution threshold is exceeded.

impact: This is close prior art for local-vorticity resolution monitoring. Differentiate the repository by its predeclared, cross-solver acceptance protocol, AMR-cap evidence, exact-reference QoIs and software-specific reproduction criteria; do not claim first discovery of the generic resolution blind spot.
limits: v1 preprint; peer-review status not established
No solver defect found or upstream issue warranted
No claim about finite-time singularity, molecular ordering, particle locations, or engineering hazard

ancillary_review.review_mode: temporary downloaded source package inspected statically; no ancillary code copied, modified, or numerically rerun

findings.evidence: concentration.py lines 19-22: positional CLI has no neutral flag and default Tend=2; lines 47-48 call step_local without override. Table 2 includes peak times beyond 2 and work-doing rows.

localize.py lines 37-42 permits neutral=False for step_local, but lines 44-52 applied_work always computes and subtracts lambda*nrm. If manually switched to unneutralized evolution, this diagnostic reports zero algebraically rather than actual work.

ancillary_review.classification: Supplementary artifact reproduction/interface gap only; not a mathematical or solver defect.
ancillary_review.disposition: No upstream issue or PR: bounded exact-title/arXiv-ID search found no maintained project issue tracker for the ancillary package; code reuse rights are not established.
